round_plan.prompt_strategy: asset-face profile only: preserve identity geometry and age, increase character specificity without reopening body, costume, hands or lighting

prompt_translation: Keep the face beautiful first, but preserve character-specific facial identity rather than averaging it into a generic AI beauty face.
Retain subtle youthful cheek volume, natural eyelids, individual mouth-corner placement and a calm character-specific gaze.
Add only restrained regional skin response and soft-tissue realism; do not increase maturity, fatigue or facial severity.
face_profile.principle: Choose a granular face profile independently from non-face realism. Beauty, age and character specificity may outrank maximal facial photorealism.

round_plan.prompt_strategy: asset-structure only: strengthen P9 robe-aware read, master-sheet framing, hand integrity and footwear readability while locking approved face and costume design

robe_rules: Use waist placement, central vertical panels, hem opening and visible foot-to-hem relation to preserve the tall read under long robes.
Do not let oversized sleeves or excessive hem width suppress the lower-body visual length.
Do not shorten the torso, extreme-shrink the head, or stretch only one leg segment.
prompt_translation: Maintain a clear P9 fashion-asset proportion even under layered long robes: refined head-to-body read, elongated neck-to-waist rhythm, naturally elevated waist, strong vertical garment lines and a readable foot-to-hem relationship.
Keep the torso anatomically complete and lengthen the lower-body impression through balanced hip-knee-ankle relationships rather than artificial leg stretching.
Control sleeve and hem width so the costume supports height instead of visually compressing it.
fashion_asset.principle: P9 asset proportion is preserved through body landmarks AND garment visual cues; never solve a robe-covered figure by simply stretching the legs.

prompt_translation: Place both hands in a clean elegant crossed-hand arrangement in front of the body, with a clear primary hand and supporting hand rather than ambiguous interlacing.

Each visible hand must have exactly five anatomically coherent digits, natural finger-length hierarchy, believable knuckles and a clear wrist direction; sleeves must not obscure the critical finger-root structure.
hand_pose.principle: Hands are a generation-time structural constraint for asset portraits, not only a post-generation repair item.

prompt_translation: Compose the character as a clean master asset portrait: full body visible from the top of the hair ornament to the shoes, centered, front-facing and upright, with balanced negative space and a pure white seamless background.
Keep the hem controlled rather than excessively spread, and keep the footwear clearly readable so the full-body scale and costume construction can be used as a reusable character asset master.

round_plan.prompt_strategy: asset material/light only: separate fabric layers, embroidery and gauze response, improve white-edge separation and grounded studio light while locking identity, proportion and framing

prompt_translation: Separate the garment materials clearly: the main robe should feel denser and more structured, the outer gauze lighter and semi-transparent, the gold floral patterns woven or embroidered rather than printed, and the waist/collar/tie structures visibly more defined.
Do not let all layers share the same soft glossy fantasy surface.
material_separation.principle: Material separation is a structural readability problem, not a request for more texture everywhere.

prompt_translation: Use a premium high-key studio setup: a large soft key from slightly front-left and above, weaker frontal fill, and only a very subtle separation light for pale gauze edges.
Keep the white background clean but not clipped; preserve a soft grounded floor shadow, clear face modeling, readable fabric hierarchy and restrained gold-thread highlights.
